concerns.text: FR-001 requires that the system not only downloads GSM8K but also verifies that subsequent runs hit the local cache to avoid repeated network calls. No task in tasks.md checks or tests the caching behavior (e.g., a test that runs the download script twice and asserts no network request on the second run).

FR-001 and Constitution Principle III mandate checksum validation before any downstream use of the GSM8K data. Tasks T041 and T041a generate SHA‑256 checksums, but there is no completed task that enforces validation of those checksums prior to data consumption (task T044 is listed as pending). This leaves the checksum enforcement gap uncovered.
